displayName: Vertex AI suggestions: slow model responses (p95 over 5 s)

documentation.content: Extractor v2's total latency at Vertex (`model_invocation_latencies`, `latency_type = total`) had a p95 above 5 s over 15 minutes, with at least 3 calls in that window so one slow call can't fire it. Healthy p95 is about 2.1-2.2 s (development, 180 calls) and the Worker gives up at 10 s, so this fires before customers start losing suggestions to timeouts. Source: scripts/gcp/monitoring/README.md.

conditions.displayName: p95 total latency of gemini-3.5-flash-lite above 5,000 ms over 15 min

conditionThreshold.filter: resource.type = "aiplatform.googleapis.com/PublisherModel" AND resource.labels.model_user_id = "gemini-3.5-flash-lite" AND metric.type = "aiplatform.googleapis.com/publisher/online_serving/model_invocation_latencies" AND metric.labels.latency_type = "total"

conditions.displayName: at least 3 gemini-3.5-flash-lite calls in the same 15 min
